title: Everyone Ai
one_liner: Self-service AI workspace platform for launching Claude Code environments via Kubernetes.
what_it_is: A web portal and CLI tool that allows teams to provision isolated VS Code workspaces backed by Claude Code on a shared k3s cluster. It manages the lifecycle of workspace pods, handles ingress routing via Traefik, and provides an app catalog for pre-configured development templates.
how_its_built: The system consists of a Node.js Express server acting as the portal API and frontend host, communicating with a k3s Kubernetes cluster via the official k8s client. Workspaces are deployed as individual pods running code-server. An accompanying CLI ('afterburner') handles cluster bootstrapping via SSH and Helm chart deployment.
how_to_apply: Operators use the 'afterburner' CLI to bootstrap a Linux VM into a k3s node and deploy the portal via Helm. End-users connect via VPN, access the portal URL, select a template from the App Catalog, and launch a browser-based VS Code instance with Claude Code pre-installed.
quickstart:
npx afterburner bootstrap --host <ip> --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
npx afterburner install
helm install everyone-ai-portal ./charts/portal -f profiles/k3s.yaml -f config.yaml --namespace myteam --create-namespace
features: One-click launch of Claude Code VS Code workspaces
Interactive CLI for k3s cluster bootstrapping and Helm deployment
App Catalog with pre-configured templates (Python, Node.js, HR Agent)
Real-time workspace provisioning status via Server-Sent Events
Team-based isolation and usage monitoring dashboard
Automated Traefik IngressRoute creation for workspace access
